units.evidence: Current faculty department listing establishes the unit. Its own page describes optimization, mathematical models, simulations and algorithms for organizational decisions. It encompasses Management Accounting & Operations Management and Decision Analytics; the current faculty area list also retains Decision and Operation Technologies with an acting professor, and its scope page describes container-logistics optimization.

limitations: Named operations professorships are represented through their current umbrella department to avoid a redundant hierarchy. The old DOT page is not treated as current staffing evidence: it announces a 2025 move; the faculty directory still lists the area under acting representation.
